panels.title: Inbound HTTP requests
Requests by endpoint
panels.description: A request that matched no route counts under the endpoint "unmatched".

panels.title: Non-2xx responses by endpoint and status code

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint, code) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_http_requests_total{code!~"2..", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_http_requests_total{code!~"2..", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0))

panels.title: Request latency by endpoint (p90)
panels.description: The search endpoint includes searches the cache answered.

panels.title: Searches from clients
Searches, by outcome
panels.description: Every search reaches exactly one outcome.

panels.title: Search result cache
Share of searches answered from the cache
Search result cache failures, by action
panels.description: A lookup failure sends the query to the network. A store failure lets the next query pay again.

panels.title: Searches sent to peers
How long a network search took
Share of the results that came from a single peer
panels.description: The peer that supplied the most, against the whole ranking.

panels.title: Unique items in the final ranking
panels.description: The ranking limit applies after duplicate items are removed.

panels.title: Share of the results that could be scored on their text
panels.description: Scoring the text needs how often the query words occur in a page and how long it is. Either the peer that holds the word reports it, or the page is read.

panels.title: Queries sent whole to each peer
How long asking peers the whole query took
Share of the asked peers that answered
panels.description: The rest were unreachable or slower than the time the query allows them.

panels.title: Queries joined across peers, one word each
Share of the joined documents that arrived with their metadata
panels.description: A joined document is one every query word led to. Metadata is the title, address and dates a result is shown with, and a joined document without it costs a second round of calls.

panels.title: Share of the documents needing metadata the query requested
panels.description: One query requests metadata for a limited number of documents. When more joined documents need it, the documents that the most peers hold are requested and the rest are dropped.

panels.title: Share of the requested documents whose metadata arrived
panels.description: A document whose metadata no peer sends back drops out of the results.

panels.title: How long a joined query took
Share of multi-word queries that joined no document
panels.description: No single document was held for every word of the query.

targets.legendFormat: no document held all query words

panels.title: Peers asked which documents they hold
panels.description: A peer counts once, whatever amount of query words it is responsible for.

panels.title: Share of the asked peers that answered which documents they hold
panels.description: The rest were unreachable or slower than the time the query allows them.

panels.title: Share of the query words no peer had a document for
panels.description: One empty word leaves the whole query with no result.

panels.title: Share of the matched documents that carried a posting
panels.description: A posting carries how often the word occurs in the document, and only a peer that stores the word sends one. Counted over every document a peer matched, including the ones the join drops.

panels.title: Pages read for a search
Pages read, by outcome
How long reading the pages of a search took
panels.description: The page read budget bounds it, and takes its share of the query budget.

panels.title: Known peers
Known peers vs directory capacity
panels.description: A peer that answered no probe stays in the directory, but no search asks it.

panels.title: Directory changes, by kind
panels.description: A refresh cycle changes the directory in one burst.

panels.title: Ring distance from a query term to the peer picked for it
panels.description: Zero means the picked peer sits exactly where the term belongs on the ring.

panels.title: Peer calls during a search
Calls that asked which documents match the query, by outcome
panels.description: Unreadable means an answer arrived that did not parse.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="matched items", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="matched items", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0))

panels.title: Calls that asked which documents a peer holds for one word, by outcome
panels.description: Only a query of more than one word makes these calls.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="held documents", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="held documents", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0))

panels.title: Calls that asked a peer for the metadata of documents, by outcome
panels.description: The second round of a query of more than one word, for the documents that came back without metadata.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="url metadata", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_peer_calls_total{asked_for="url metadata", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0))

panels.title: How long an answered peer call took
panels.description: Only the peer calls a peer answered. The peer call budget bounds it.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (clamp_min(yacydhtsearch_peer_call_duration_seconds_bucket{outcome=~"answered|answered nothing", instance=~"$service_instance"} - (yacydhtsearch_peer_call_duration_seconds_bucket{outcome=~"answered|answered nothing", instance=~"$service_instance"} offset $__interval), 0))
